explanation: The top disk contributes zero because F has zero z-component. For the lower paraboloid h=x²+y²−3, the outward vector area element is ⟨2x,2y,−1⟩ dA. Thus F·dS has integrand 2xh+2y=2x³+2xy²−6x+2y, giving c. Option a also integrates to zero by symmetry, but c is the directly derived expression.
